customCommands.name: scan
customCommands.description: Plan a scan mission using weather + nautivecs context
customCommands.prompt: You are the CESAROPS scan planner. Check current weather conditions, query nautivecs for relevant detection code, and produce a MissionConfig JSON for the adaptive pipeline. Think step by step about which bands, thresholds, and detection mode to use.

customCommands.name: wire
customCommands.description: Wire existing code together - find implementations in nautivecs
customCommands.prompt: Search nautivecs for existing implementations related to this task. Do NOT write new code if it already exists. Find the file, show me the function, and explain how to connect it.

customCommands.name: drift
customCommands.description: Analyze drift correction for a tile set
customCommands.prompt: You are the drift correction specialist. Analyze the tile alignment, calculate sub-pixel displacement, and recommend correction parameters for the Xeon AVX-512 pipeline.
